info.title: India EV Finder REST API
info.description:
REST API for the India EV Finder mobile app: phone-OTP login with rotating refresh tokens, station discovery, garage, favorites, reservations, reviews and trip planning.

**Auth flow:** `POST /auth/otp/send` → `POST /auth/otp/verify` returns `accessToken` (15 min) and `refreshToken` (30 days, single use). Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. On `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED` call `POST /auth/refresh` and retry; store the *new* refresh token each time.

**Errors:** every failure is `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }`. Branch on `error.code`, not the message.

**Reservations** are records in this API only; they are not enforced by charger operators.

servers.description: Production (replace with your deployed host; HTTPS required for release builds)

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token. `error.code` is UNAUTHENTICATED, INVALID_TOKEN or TOKEN_EXPIRED (refresh and retry).

ValidationError.description: Request validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_JSON, or a domain rule such as INVALID_PORT).

Conflict.description: State conflict (SLOT_TAKEN, BOOKING_LIMIT, ALREADY_REVIEWED, VEHICLE_LIMIT, STATION_OFFLINE, BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE).

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Honour the `Retry-After` header.

distanceKm.description: Present only when the request supplied coordinates

liveTelemetry.description: false: port states are estimated from freePorts/totalPorts, not read from the charger

maxChargeKw.description: Highest DC rate the vehicle accepts

connector.description: Only suggest stations with this connector

feasible.description: false when no charging plan completes the trip (battery too low, or no fast chargers on the corridor)

assumptions.description: Constants behind the estimate; this is not turn-by-turn routing

post.summary: Send a 6-digit login code by SMS
post.description: Code is valid 5 minutes, 30 s between resends, max 5 per phone per hour. In dev with ALLOW_DEMO_OTP=true the response includes `demoOtp`; never in production.

post.summary: Verify the code and sign in (creates the account on first login)
post.description: 5 wrong attempts invalidate the code (OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED). `fullName` is used only when the account is created.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Refresh tokens are single use. Replaying a used token after a 10 s retry grace window revokes the whole login (REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED). Always store the returned refresh token.

401.description: INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN or REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED. The user must sign in again.

post.summary: End this login (revokes the refresh token family)
post.description: Idempotent. Also invalidates access tokens issued in this login immediately.

delete.summary: Permanently delete the account and its data
delete.description: Removes profile, vehicles, favorites, bookings and reviews, and revokes all sessions. Required in-app by the App Store and Play Store.

get.summary: Stations near a point, nearest first
get.description: Bearer token is optional; when sent it must be valid (an expired one returns 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED so the app can refresh), and `isFavorite` is filled in.

parameters.name: connector
parameters.description: Substring match on connector type, e.g. CCS2

get.description: Bearer token is optional; when sent it must be valid (an expired one returns 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED so the app can refresh), and `isFavorite` is filled in. `meta.truncated` is true when more stations exist than `limit`; ask the user to zoom in.

parameters.name: connector
parameters.description: Substring match on connector type, e.g. CCS2

get.description: Bearer token is optional; when sent it must be valid (an expired one returns 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED so the app can refresh), and `isFavorite` is filled in. Pass `lat`+`lng` to get `distanceKm` and nearest-first ordering.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches name, address, network, city, pincode

get.summary: Station detail with ports and recent reviews
get.description: Bearer token is optional; when sent it must be valid (an expired one returns 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED so the app can refresh), and `isFavorite` is filled in.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Station id (URL-encode it; some ids contain special characters)

post.summary: Review a station (one per user per station)

post.description: Rejects overlapping reservations on the same port (SLOT_TAKEN), offline stations, and more than 3 active reservations per user. This is a record in this API only; the charger operator does not enforce it.

post.summary: Plan charging stops for a trip
post.description: Finds fast chargers (>= 25 kW, not offline) within 20 km of the straight line between origin and destination, keeping a 10% reserve. Returns `feasible: false` with warnings instead of inventing stops when coverage is missing.
